title: Maharashtra Weather Update: Heatwave and Rain Alerts Issued for October 15 - PUNE PULSE
full_text:
Maharashtra continues to experience October heat, with the India Meteorological Department (IMD) forecasting hot and humid conditions in some districts and thunderstorms with rain in others on Thursday, October 15. Mumbai, Raigad and Ratnagiri are under a heatwave warning, while parts of Western Maharashtra may experience light to moderate rainfall accompanied by lightning and gusty winds. Most districts in North Maharashtra and Vidarbha are likely to remain dry.
Mumbai, Raigad and Ratnagiri Under Heatwave Warning
According to the forecast for October 15, Palghar and Thane are likely to experience hot and humid conditions, although predominantly dry weather is expected.
Mumbai, Raigad and Ratnagiri have been issued a heatwave warning. Meanwhile, Sindhudurg may experience hot and humid conditions, followed by thunderstorms and rain during the afternoon or evening. A yellow alert has also been issued for the relevant districts in the Konkan region.
Residents are advised to take precautions against excessive heat and remain alert to changing weather conditions.
Western Maharashtra: Thunderstorms and Rain Expected
Several parts of Western Maharashtra may receive rainfall on Thursday. Pune, Pune Ghat areas, Satara, Satara Ghat areas and Sangli are likely to experience light rain accompanied by thunderstorms.
Kolhapur, Kolhapur Ghat areas and Solapur may receive light to moderate rainfall, with lightning and gusty winds. The IMD has issued yellow alerts for these areas.
People travelling through the ghat regions should remain cautious, particularly during periods of thunderstorms and strong winds.
North Maharashtra Likely to Remain Dry
Dry weather is expected across most of North Maharashtra on October 15. Dhule, Nandurbar, Jalgaon, Nashik and Nashik Ghat areas are unlikely to receive significant rainfall.
Ahilyanagar district is also expected to remain dry, with no specific rainfall forecast for the day.
Marathwada Weather Forecast: Mostly Dry Conditions
Most districts in Marathwada are likely to experience dry weather on Thursday. These include Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Jalna, Parbhani, Beed, Hingoli, Nanded and Latur.
However, light rainfall is possible in Dharashiv district. Residents should monitor local weather updates for any changes in the forecast.
Vidarbha Weather Update: No Special Warning
No specific weather warning has been indicated for the Vidarbha districts listed in the forecast for October 15. Akola, Amravati, Bhandara, Buldhana, Chandrapur, Gadchiroli, Gondia, Nagpur, Wardha, Washim and Yavatmal are expected to experience predominantly dry weather.
Safety Advisory: Precautions During Heat and Thunderstorms
With hot and humid conditions expected in parts of Maharashtra, residents should take the following precautions:
- Avoid unnecessary outdoor activities during the hottest part of the day.
- Drink plenty of water to stay hydrated.
- Wear loose-fitting, light-coloured cotton clothing.
- Use a hat, umbrella or other suitable protection when outdoors.
- During thunderstorms, seek shelter inside a sturdy building and avoid open areas.
- Stay away from trees, electric poles and exposed locations during lightning.
- Follow official IMD updates for the latest weather warnings.
Conclusion
Maharashtra is likely to experience contrasting weather conditions on October 15, with heatwave warnings in parts of the Konkan region and thunderstorms expected in Western Maharashtra. North Maharashtra and Vidarbha are likely to remain mostly dry, while light rain is possible in Dharashiv. Residents should follow official weather advisories and take appropriate precautions against heat, lightning and strong winds.
